site_year_level Expected count per unit of flight curve (level) for each site and year, from the Poisson GLM COUNT ~ factor(SITE_ID) + factor(M_YEAR) + offset(log(NM)), fitted without building the model matrix (no limit on the number of sites). The counts are first summed per site-year, with the flight curve covered (sum of NM). With method = "newton", the site effects are concentrated out of the likelihood (closed form given the year effects) and the concentrated likelihood, a multinomial per site, is maximised by Newton steps on the year effects only. One year per group of linked years (see n_components) is the reference and years without count have a level of 0. If Newton fails, iterative proportional fitting is used. With method = "ipf", iterative proportional fitting matches the fitted total of each site and each year to the observed total. Both give the maximum likelihood estimates of glm().

Source: R/rbmsExtra.r
site_year_level.Rd

site_year_level Expected count per unit of flight curve (level) for each site and year, from the Poisson GLM COUNT ~ factor(SITE_ID) + factor(M_YEAR) + offset(log(NM)), fitted without building the model matrix (no limit on the number of sites). The counts are first summed per site-year, with the flight curve covered (sum of NM). With method = "newton", the site effects are concentrated out of the likelihood (closed form given the year effects) and the concentrated likelihood, a multinomial per site, is maximised by Newton steps on the year effects only. One year per group of linked years (see n_components) is the reference and years without count have a level of 0. If Newton fails, iterative proportional fitting is used. With method = "ipf", iterative proportional fitting matches the fitted total of each site and each year to the observed total. Both give the maximum likelihood estimates of glm().

Usage

site_year_level(
  site,
  year,
  count,
  nm,
  method = c("newton", "ipf"),
  tol = 1e-08,
  maxit = NULL
)

Arguments

site

vector Site id of each count.

year

vector Year of each count.

count

numeric Observed counts.

nm

numeric Proportion of the flight curve (NM) of each count, > 0.

method

character Fitting method, "newton" (default) or "ipf".

tol

numeric Tolerance for convergence, default 1e-8.

maxit

integer Maximum number of iterations, default 100 for Newton and 10000 for IPF.

Value

numeric vector The level of the site-year of each count, the fitted count being level * nm. The attribute "effects" is a list with the site (site) and year (year) multiplicative effects, named by site and year, level = site x year (the scale between them is arbitrary, their product is not). With Newton, the attribute "year_effect" is a data.table with, per year, the group of linked years (GROUP), the log year effect relative to the first year of the group (LOG_EFFECT, -Inf for years without count), its standard error (SE) scaled by the quasi-Poisson dispersion and conditional on the site totals, and the dispersion (DISPERSION).
